name: Town wall
_about: A STRETCH OF TOWN WALL: its top is the wall-walk, behind a crenellated parapet on the field side (+z) and a low one on the town side; the parapets stop short of a tower astride the wall (the river ends), the field one runs into a tower flanking it (between: town.js) and the town-side one runs on behind it, run into a corner tower, and meet a gatehouse's face (pa/pb, ia/ib); built with `stair` (and the town-side parapet in two, `inner parapet by the stair` and `past the stair`) it has a flight up from the town.

params._fp: the field parapet's thickness (its inner face is the walk's field edge) and ri how far in from the town face the town-side rail stands: the walk's middle is (fp - ri) / 2 in from the wall's line toward the town (town.js frame.walkIn: the watchman and the sentry walk it)
params._len: the segment's length (centre of one tower to the next, or to a gatehouse's face), h its walk's height, T its thickness; sx where the flight up starts (it climbs +x along the town face to a 1.3m landing: sx + Lf + 1.3 must stay short of the +x end)
params._pa: where the field parapet stops short of the -x end (pa) and the +x end (pb): 2.8 at a tower astride the wall, where a flanking tower meets it (town.js flankStop; ia 0 there: the town side runs on), 0.7 at a corner tower (it runs into the tower), 0 at a gatehouse's face; ia/ib the same for the town-side parapet (T/2 - 0.15 at a corner: it runs to the corner, where it meets the other wall's), ka/kb 0 where its end post is the other wall's (one post at the corner, not two side by side)
